name: CYOA Choices
description: Append 3-5 numbered action choices at the end of every response
author: Purachina
prompt:
### CYOA Choices
Add a player-choice block after the scene reply. When this runs as a repair task, the choice block is the full result. Choices are from {{user}}’s perspective and describe possible next actions.

Use this format with 3-7 numbered options:
[CHOICES]
1. Action description
2. Action description
3. Action description
[/CHOICES]
